intro_section.title: Explore Beyond Occidental Papagayo
paragraphs: Occidental Papagayo is an adults-only all-inclusive resort on the Gulf of Papagayo, approximately 23 to 30 minutes from Liberia airport (LIR). When you are ready to step outside the resort for the day, Wild Papagayo organizes private tours with direct pickup from the hotel.

Every experience in this guide departs from and returns to Occidental Papagayo. Day trips range from a shorter outing of about six hours to full days of eight or nine hours in Costa Rica's national parks, volcanic landscapes and wildlife reserves. Exact pickup time is confirmed after booking based on your selected experience and travel date.
One group. One vehicle. One guide. No shared buses. No other travelers on your schedule.

featured_tours.title: Six Private Tours from Occidental Papagayo

tours.note: Swim at Llanos del Cortes waterfall, then visit Las Pumas Wildlife Rescue Center — pumas, jaguars, ocelots and monkeys. Lunch included. About 6 hours.
Three suspension bridges, Llanos de Cortez waterfall and a sloth encounter. Lunch included. Sightings are frequent but not guaranteed. About 9 hours.
Las Pailas Trail through fumaroles and mud pots at Rincón de la Vieja. Classic (waterfall) or Plus (hot springs) options. About 8 hours. Runs Tuesday through Sunday — park closed Mondays.
Full-day hike to Río Celeste at Tenorio Volcano National Park. Swimming is not permitted in the river. Park entrance fee included. About 9 hours. Minimum age 8.
Covered boat through Palo Verde National Park. Crocodiles, howler monkeys and tropical birds along the Tempisque River. Half day. Ages 2+.
Hidden waterfalls and tropical forest, reserved exclusively for your group. Certified bilingual guide. About 8 hours. Minimum age 4.

faq.q: Can Wild Papagayo arrange pickup directly from Occidental Papagayo?
faq.a: Yes. Wild Papagayo coordinates direct hotel pickup from Occidental Papagayo. Exact pickup time is confirmed after booking based on your selected tour and travel date.

faq.q: What private tours are available from Occidental Papagayo?
faq.a: Six tours are listed in this guide, ranging from about 6 to about 9 hours: Waterfall & Las Pumas, Hanging Bridges & Sloths, Rincón de la Vieja Hiking, Celeste River Hike, Palo Verde River Boat and Waterfall Lovers. All include direct hotel pickup.

faq.q: How long is the drive from Occidental Papagayo to Rincón de la Vieja?
faq.a: As general Papagayo-area planning context, the drive is approximately 93 to 118 minutes each way. Actual travel time depends on the hotel pickup location, route, and road conditions. The hiking tour takes about 8 hours and runs Tuesday through Sunday, as the national park is closed on Mondays.

faq.q: Is the Celeste River Hike worth the drive from Occidental Papagayo?
faq.a: Yes, for couples who want a full nature day and are comfortable with a longer drive. Approximately 110 to 140 minutes each way, depending on pickup location and road conditions. The hike itself takes about 9 hours and is rated Moderate. Swimming is not permitted in Río Celeste. Park registration requires visitor identification details.

faq.q: Are tours at Occidental Papagayo private?
faq.a: Yes. Every Wild Papagayo experience is reserved exclusively for your group. No shared buses, no other travelers added to your group.

Yes, Occidental Papagayo is an adults-only all-inclusive resort. Wild Papagayo private tours from Occidental are designed with couples in mind, with flexible pacing and itineraries tailored to your group.
